items.description: Laptop accidental damage repair (cracked screen and lower-right corner), combined line settled with shop
items.rationale: Covered under 2.6.1/2.6.2 (swerve in conveyance) with both damage areas one loss per 2.6.3; combined line and direct settlement permitted by 7.1.12. Priced at reference level for screen plus corner repair (approx. 808 + 342), capped by replacement value of the unit.
